scope: Same-assistant semantic annotation using opaque candidate IDs and the existing Sudan rubric. The two byte-identical original team records retain their original annotations. Evidence order and draft use were tested after the archive was examined. This comparison uses one exposed docket and one frozen writer.

access_provenance.support: The proposed text concerned ending hostilities in Sudan, protecting civilians and facilitating humanitarian access. The vote did not adopt these measures in S/2024/826.

delivered_revisions.independent_drafts/revision_1: The Russian Federation cast the sole negative vote on draft S/2024/826, opposing it as a route for outside interference in Sudan's internal affairs (VOTE, RU-A). A key qualification is that the delegation argued justice administration must remain exclusively with the Government of Sudan (RU-A).
delivered_revisions.independent_drafts/revision_2: China voted in favour of draft S/2024/826 to support an immediate ceasefire and de-escalation in Sudan to protect civilians (CN-A). Fu Cong noted that some constructive proposals and concerns had not been fully reflected in the text (CN-A).
delivered_revisions.interactive/revision_1: The Russian Federation delegation opposed draft S/2024/826, arguing it enabled outside interference and that justice must remain under the Government of Sudan (RU-A). The draft failed to adopt these measures because the Russian Federation cast the sole negative vote (VOTE).
